lastCompletedStory.title: Add configPath seam to RunPlanPhaseOptions with red-swept planner and auditor codex regression tests

nextStoryContext: US-002 (CAM-420) added an optional configPath field to RunPlanPhaseOptions (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts), doc-commented in the style of MakeReviewDispatchOptions.configPath / RunSupervisorOptions.configPath (US-001 of this same PRD). The two dispatch-resolution call sites (readPhaseBackend('planner'|'auditor', configPath) and the resolvePhaseModel({ ..., configPath }) call immediately below each) are inside resolveAndSpawnPlanner/resolveAndSpawnAuditor, which this story converted from 11 positional parameters each to a single shared ResolveAndSpawnOptions object (issue AC3: adding configPath as a 12th positional was explicitly disallowed). The object's field name for the pane id is `paneId` (generic, since the same function body is reused for both phases via the hardcoded 'planner'/'auditor' string literal internal to each function); callers (runPlannerSpawnStep/runAuditorSpawnStep) build the object literal from their already-destructured RunPlanPhaseOptions fields, now including configPath. When configPath is omitted, both readPhaseBackend and resolvePhaseModel already treat a missing/undefined configPath as 'use the live scripts/cam/project.toml from process.cwd()', so omitting the field preserves production behavior byte-for-byte (proved by the whole existing suite staying green with zero test edits, AC3). Red-sweep record (issue AC7, restated per AC5 of this story): the new test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts file (two tests: planner-site and auditor-site codex regressions) was copied into a fresh git worktree of unmodified main (git worktree add /tmp/cam-main-redsweep-us002 main; bun install --frozen-lockfile inside the worktree), then run there with `bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts`. Measured result on main: 2 fail / 0 pass, both failing at the `expect(authCheckCalled).toBe(true)` assertion with authCheckCalled still false -- on main, RunPlanPhaseOptions has no configPath field, so resolveAndSpawnPlanner/resolveAndSpawnAuditor call readPhaseBackend('planner'|'auditor') with no second argument, resolving the worktree's own live scripts/cam/project.toml (backend='claude' for both phases) instead of the tmpdir fixture, so codexAuthPreflight's backend!=='codex' short-circuit means the injected codexAuthCheckFn is never invoked for either phase. On this branch (with the seam wired in) the same file is green (2 pass / 0 fail). The worktree was removed after the sweep (git worktree remove --force). Neither test needed a process.chdir(): .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md and subagent-auditor.md are already committed at the repo root (needed by CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv), so only the configPath fixture path varies per test, mirroring the review.ts US-006/CAM-398 'pre-existing configPath DI seam needs zero chdir' precedent (patterns.md). Any downstream story touching the planner/auditor dispatch call sites in plan-runner.ts should keep readPhaseBackend/resolvePhaseModel's configPath argument threaded through the shared ResolveAndSpawnOptions object, never re-adding a bare positional parameter to resolveAndSpawnPlanner/resolveAndSpawnAuditor.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal DI-seam wiring story: no new external library surface introduced. Both readPhaseBackend(phase, configPath?) and resolvePhaseModel({..., configPath?}) already accepted an optional configPath argument in src/config/models.ts and src/config/model-resolution.ts prior to this story; this story only threads the pre-existing internal signatures through a new RunPlanPhaseOptions field (and a new shared ResolveAndSpawnOptions object replacing 11 positional parameters), mirroring the already-shipped loop.ts (US-001, CAM-420) and review.ts (US-001, CAM-405) seams.
